text: Whether he is a man or not I cannot tell, for I have never seen him.” “How can I get there?” asked Dorothy. “You must walk. It is a long journey, through a country that is sometimes pleasant and sometimes dark and terrible. However, I will use all the magic arts I know of to keep you from harm.” “Won’t you go with me?” pleaded the girl, who had begun to look upon the little old woman as her only friend. “No, I cannot do that,” she replied, “but I will give you my kiss, and no one will dare injure a person who has been kissed by the Witch of the North.” She came close to Dorothy and kissed her gently on the forehead.
